title: Summer Holiday Bucket List: 30 Family Day Out Ideas
description: A summer holiday bucket list with 30 family day out ideas for kids and teens: free adventures, water fun, big days out, rainy-day backups and teen favourites.
h1: The summer holiday bucket list: 30 day out ideas
intro: Six weeks, one bucket list. Print it, stick it on the fridge and tick them off. There’s something here for toddlers, teens and grown-ups.

image.alt: A family flying a kite in a field under a clear blue sky

keywords: things to do in the summer holidays
cardText: Thirty summer day out ideas for every age and budget.

blocks.title: Scout’s summer plan
blocks.text: Mix free days with one or two big treats, and keep two rainy-day ideas up your sleeve. British summer, eh!

faqs.q: What can kids do in the summer holidays for free?
faqs.a: Beaches, rock pooling, parks, forests, free museums, skate parks, bike rides, geocaching and local festivals are all free or nearly free.
